# Test & Demo Invoices

A curated set of invoice fixtures that exercise every route through the AP
Copilot pipeline — the happy paths and the negative / edge cases a client demo
should show. They are generated by
[`../generate_invoices.py`](../generate_invoices.py) and are deliberately
aligned with the mock master data in [`app/config.py`](../../../app/config.py)
(the S/4HANA PO ledger and the posted-invoice history that duplicate detection queries) so PO matching, duplicate
detection and routing all resolve coherently.

> Rule reference (live values come from Firestore `policies/ap_rules`; defaults in
> `app/config.py`): an invoice routes to **human review** if its total exceeds
> **$4,000**, a required field is missing or not grounded in the document, the total
> is invalid, or line items don't reconcile to the total. It is **escalated** if it
> was already posted: the same invoice number from the same vendor, or the same
> vendor, PO and amount, is found in the Firestore `posted_invoices` collection.
> Otherwise it posts straight through — **direct** spend → SAP CIMS, **indirect** →
> Coupa AP. Seed Firestore (`deployment/seed_firestore.py`) before running scenarios
> 4 and 5: they need that posted-invoice history to collide with.

## Scenarios

| # | File | Vendor | Invoice / PO | Total | What it demonstrates | Expected outcome |
|---|------|--------|--------------|-------|----------------------|------------------|
| — | [`../sample_invoice.pdf`](../sample_invoice.pdf) | Helix Cloud Services | `INV-2026-0042` / `PO-2026-2007` | $4,750 | **Default** sample invoice (indirect, over limit) | Human review → approve → **Coupa AP** |
| 1 | `01_direct_straight_through.pdf` | BluePeak Plastics | `INV-2026-0301` / `PO-2026-1003` | $3,250 | Clean **direct** invoice under the limit | Straight-through → **SAP CIMS** ✅ |
| 2 | `02_indirect_straight_through.pdf` | BrightOffice Supplies Co | `INV-2026-0302` / `PO-2026-2002` | $920 | Clean **indirect** invoice under the limit | Straight-through → **Coupa AP** ✅ |
| 3 | `03_high_value_approval.pdf` | Meridian Steel & Alloys | `INV-2026-0303` / `PO-2026-1010` | $12,500 | **High-value** invoice (> $4k and > $10k) | Human review → approve → **SAP CIMS** |
| 4 | `04_duplicate_invoice_number.pdf` | Cascade Components Inc | `INV-2024-001` / `PO-2026-1002` | $5,400 | **Duplicate invoice number** (already booked) | Escalate → **ServiceNow ticket** 🔴 |
| 5 | `05_duplicate_po.pdf` | Globex Trading Co | `INV-2026-0305` / `PO-2026-0098` | $6,000 | **Duplicate PO** (already fully invoiced) | Escalate → **ServiceNow ticket** 🔴 |
| 6 | `06_malformed_po_missing_fields.pdf` | Globex Trading Co | `2026/887-A` / *(no PO)* | $2,750 | **Missing PO** + non-standard invoice format | Human review → reject → **vendor email** |
| 7 | `07_blurry_scan.pdf` (+ `.png`) | Helix Cloud Services | `INV-2026-0307` / `PO-2026-2007` | $4,750 | **Blurry photographed scan** | Low confidence → **human review** |
| 8 | `08_business_rule_violation_zero_total.pdf` | Globex Trading Co | `INV-2026-0308` / `PO-2026-2011` | $0.00 | **Invalid total** (zero / not finalized) | Human review (invalid amount) |

Notes:
- Scenarios 7 and 8 depend on what Gemini extracts (confidence / total). The
  deterministic rule-engine behaviour for the equivalent records is asserted in
  [`tests/unit/test_scenarios.py`](../../unit/test_scenarios.py); the live LLM
  outcome may vary slightly but should land on the same route.
- `07_blurry_scan.pdf` wraps a degraded image (no embedded text) so the
  multimodal extraction model must read it as a scan — driving low confidence.

## Running a specific invoice

Intake is **live AgentMail only** (the inbox configured via the `AGENTMAIL_INBOX_ID`
env var); there is no mock intake mode. To exercise a specific scenario, email
the corresponding fixture PDF (or `sample_invoice.pdf`) to that mailbox just before a run, then trigger
*Fetch & process latest invoice*. The deterministic rule-engine outcomes for the
equivalent records are asserted in
[`tests/unit/test_scenarios.py`](../../unit/test_scenarios.py).

## Regenerating

```bash
uv run python tests/fixtures/generate_invoices.py
```

Requires the `dev` dependency group (`reportlab`, `pillow`). Edit the scenario
specs in the generator to change vendors, amounts, or PO references — keep PO
numbers in sync with `MOCK_PO_DATABASE` / `MOCK_POSTED_INVOICES` in
`app/config.py` (re-seed Firestore with `deployment/seed_firestore.py`).
